description.value:
Duration constant

Immunity to frightened, with a favor to spare for a scared ally.

You're immune to the frightened condition. Once per day, when an ally within 30 feet would become frightened, you may let them draw on your certainty instead — they become frightened 1 lower than they would have (minimum 0).

cinderfall.incomplete: The ally-facing clause ("once per day, an ally within 30 feet may draw on your certainty instead of becoming frightened, reducing the value by 1") is P-CROSS: reducing a DIFFERENT creature's incoming condition value, sourced from the card holder's own once-per-day passive, has no selector anywhere in pf2e-source. Contrast unshaken/steel-the-account (SKIP, P-CONDVAL), which are the identical mechanic but SELF-only and match pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/elf/level-13/cold-iron-stomach.json's real precedent -- the ally version is the confirmed-absent case.
